title: Cache security group resolution in Effective Permissions
summary: Effective Permissions Mgt. now caches the security-group access control filter per user, and page 9853 reuses the page's global instance, so Entra group membership is resolved once per user instead of on every row. This targets slow exports of effective permissions to Excel.
key_points: GetAccessControlFilterForUser results cached in a Dictionary keyed by user security ID
SetRecordAndRefresh on page 9853 uses the global EffectivePermissionsMgt instead of a local instance
In the author's measurement, moving through rows no longer adds GetMembers calls
Cache lasts while the page is open and starts empty when reopened
Group membership changes made while the page is open show only after reopening
quote: Exporting one user's effective permissions to Excel made about 196K backend calls (about 4 minutes) for a tenant with 36 security groups
